::: {#exr-halving-stops}
#### A loop that halves

The algorithm `halvings` takes a natural number (@def-natural-numbers) $n$
and counts how many times $n$ can be halved, rounding down, before it reaches 1:

```text
procedure halvings(n)    // n is a natural number
    k := n
    c := 0
    while k >= 2
        k := floor(k / 2)
        c := c + 1
    return c
```

Here `floor(x)` is the largest integer that is at most `x`.
Explain why the loop stops for every natural number $n$.

:::
